question: What status among poets results from attaining formidable accomplishment in speech?
premises: The practitioner attains formidable speech accomplishment.
Poets form the relevant field of excellence.
The result is preeminence among them.
inference: Having attained formidable speech accomplishment, one would become foremost among poets.
plain_english: Having attained formidable accomplishment in speech, one would become foremost among poets.
